aboutpara: I'm currently CTO at Ofir Labs, a startup currently focused on developing the Raya Culture platform. As such, I have acquired experience in the entire technological area of the same platform, as well as infrastructure, strategy and product development. Some of the technologies are: React Native, NestJS, Next.js, Postgres, Cloudflare, Redis, AWS, CI/CD, Jira, etc. As well as this, I also have past experience in large, agile (Scrum) projects, and cutting-edge technologies such as Azure DevOps, Git, C#, WPF, WCF, Spring Boot, Ionic Framework, Oracle DB and MySQL. I did my academic education at FCUP where I attended the Integrated Masters in Network and Computer Systems Engineering.
